name: Godot UI Components (provenance review required)
description: Collection of polished Godot 4 UI implementations. Repository code is MIT, but several showcased designs explicitly credit third-party design studios, so commercial reuse of the visual designs is not assumed from the code licence.

licence.identifier: MIT (repository software); third-party visual-design rights unresolved
licence.notice: MIT covers the repository software. README credits multiple component designs to external studios/Dribbble sources; the MIT code licence is not evidence that those underlying visual designs can be commercially copied.

provenance.notes: Implementation authorship is clear, but the README explicitly attributes several visual designs to Sok Studio, Koncepted, RH and Layer Lab. Rights to reproduce those designs in a commercial By JTT product have not been established.

maintenance.evidence: Repository is public and not archived; last source push shown by GitHub was 2024-04-27.
maintenance.notes: Maintenance is secondary to the unresolved visual-design provenance blocker.

compatibility.notes: Technical compatibility is plausible but has not been executed because provenance blocks qualification first.

risk.legalNotes: P0/P1-style commercial adoption blocker for copied credited designs: repository software licence and underlying design rights are distinct. A clean-room implementation inspired only by general UI patterns may be a different analysis, but must not copy protected expression without permission.
risk.securityNotes: No special security concern identified from discovery; normal Godot code review would apply if provenance is resolved.

assessment.notes: Do not adopt component visuals into a commercial project until exact design rights are resolved. May remain useful as a private pattern/reference lead without copying protected designs.

evidence.notes: README credits multiple showcased visual designs to third-party studios/Dribbble sources.

publication.notes: Internal quarantine example; do not include in the public library until provenance/commercial rights are resolved.
